mapper.sql: select credential_id, credential_code, credential_type, draft_revision_id, published_revision_id, previous_published_revision_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from site_credential
mapper.select: del_flag='0' and credential_code like concat('%', #{credentialCode}, '%') and credential_type=#{credentialType} order by credential_id desc
where credential_id=#{credentialId} and del_flag='0' for update
mapper.insert: insert into site_credential (credential_code, credential_type, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{credentialCode}, #{credentialType}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update site_credential set credential_code=#{credentialCode}, credential_type=#{credentialType}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate(), remark=#{remark} where credential_id=#{credentialId} and del_flag='0'

update site_credential set draft_revision_id=#{draftRevisionId}, published_revision_id=#{publishedRevisionId}, previous_published_revision_id=#{previousPublishedRevisionId}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate() where credential_id=#{credentialId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select r.revision_id, r.credential_id, r.revision_no, r.revision_state, r.title, r.document_media_id, m.public_id as document_public_id, r.content_hash, r.published_by, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark from site_credential_revision r left join site_media m on m.media_id=r.document_media_id where r.revision_id=#{revisionId}

select r.revision_id, r.credential_id, r.revision_no, r.revision_state, r.title, r.document_media_id, m.public_id as document_public_id, r.content_hash, r.published_by, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark from site_credential_revision r left join site_media m on m.media_id=r.document_media_id where r.credential_id=#{credentialId} and r.revision_state='DRAFT' order by r.revision_no desc limit 1
select coalesce(max(revision_no),0)+1 from site_credential_revision where credential_id=#{credentialId}
mapper.insert: insert into site_credential_revision (credential_id, revision_no, revision_state, title, document_media_id, content_hash, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{credentialId}, #{revisionNo}, #{revisionState}, #{title}, #{documentMediaId}, #{contentHash}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update site_credential_revision set title=#{title}, document_media_id=#{documentMediaId}, content_hash=#{contentHash}, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate(), remark=#{remark} where revision_id=#{revisionId} and revision_state='DRAFT'

update site_credential_revision set revision_state=#{revisionState}, published_at=case when #{revisionState}='PUBLISHED' then sysdate() else published_at end, published_by=case when #{revisionState}='PUBLISHED' then #{publishedBy} else published_by end where revision_id=#{revisionId}
mapper.insert: insert into site_publish_audit (aggregate_type, aggregate_id, action_type, from_revision_id, to_revision_id, operator, reason) values ('CREDENTIAL', #{aggregateId}, #{actionType}, #{fromRevisionId}, #{toRevisionId}, #{operator}, #{reason})
